   Add multiply to calc, with tests and README docs

   Context

   calc.py is a two-function module (add, subtract) with no tests and a three-line
   README that doesn't document the API. The ask is to round it out: a third operation,
   test coverage for all three, and a README section that lists what the module offers.

   Assumption worth flagging: there is no test framework in the repo and no dependency
   file, so tests use unittest from the standard library — runnable with no install step.
   Say the word if pytest is preferred; the test bodies stay the same either way.

   Steps

   1. Add multiply to calc.py — append def multiply(a, b): return a * b below
   subtract, matching the existing two-blank-line spacing and bare-return style. No
   type hints or docstrings, since neither existing function has them.
   2. Create test_calc.py — one unittest.TestCase per function (TestAdd,
   TestSubtract, TestMultiply). Each covers positives, negatives, and zero;
   multiply also covers the identity case (x * 1). End with the standard
   if __name__ == "__main__": unittest.main() block.
   3. Add a Functions section to README.md — a ## Functions heading under the
   existing description, listing add(a, b), subtract(a, b), multiply(a, b) with a
   one-line description each.
   4. Verify — run python -m unittest test_calc -v from the project root and confirm
   all cases pass.

   Files

   - calc.py — modified
   - test_calc.py — new                                                                                                                                ↓
